critical_code_review_comments: whatsapp_link.py:341 campaign_action('cancel') — for a status=='draft' campaign, services.wa_campaigns.set_status should allow cancel. Task says 'cancel allowed for drafts'. Currently untested against a real draft (no drafts exist); ensure set_status treats 'draft' as a cancellable state alongside 'queued'/'paused' to avoid a stuck-draft footgun.

whatsapp_link.py:376 inbox self-filter compares last 10 digits of salon's phone to sender — safe for Indian numbers but if salon phone stored with a shorter local format (<10 digits) it would over-filter guests whose number ends with the same suffix. Consider anchoring on exact digit match >= 10 digits.

whatsapp_link.py:352 GET /inbox — no cache/ETag; each open re-fetches up to 500 messages from gateway (20s timeout). If owners toggle Replies repeatedly, this hammers the gateway. Consider 30s in-memory cache per tenant.
poster_text.py — headline/salon/subline font size is baked; a very long tenant name may overflow the lower band. Add auto-shrink or ellipsis for names >30 chars.

WaCampaignBits.jsx MiraDrafts approve button lacks confirm dialog — one accidental tap on 'Approve & send' fires 50-1000 WhatsApp messages. Given LIVE gateway, wrap in a confirm modal or two-tap (Preview → Confirm).
